annotations.title: What can I join or do near me

description: What a person can join or do near a U.S. ZIP code or street address: upcoming public meetings and hearings for their city or town (with the source and when we checked it), open member polls (not representative), petitions, town halls and AMAs, and the officials who represent them with a pointer to get_person for contact routes. Empty lists mean we have nothing for that place, not that nothing is happening. An address is sent to the U.S. Census geocoder only to find the place and is not stored.
